description: Median time to clinical presentation by regimen, FAERS with reports from Japan removed
statistic: 25th, 50th and 75th percentiles of time to clinical presentation, and the ratio of medians between regimens
regimen: combination anti-PD-(L)1 plus anti-CTLA-4 versus anti-PD-1 monotherapy
note: spontaneous reports; the combination group includes durvalumab plus tremelimumab

description: Clinically recognised severe myocarditis without cardiac screening
statistic: incidence of clinical presentation, and the ratio between regimens
regimen: nivolumab plus ipilimumab versus nivolumab alone
uncertainty: binomial on derived denominators; used as a lower bound, with the ratio fitted
note: per-regimen denominators are not reported in the source; see the note in extraction.csv

statistic: share with myocardial damage, and the distribution of time to detection
note: damage is a troponin rise and/or an LVEF fall of more than 10 points to below 53 percent

description: Screening before every infusion in advanced lung cancer, 298 patients
statistic: myocarditis incidence and the distribution of onset
assay: hs-cTnI above 34 ng/L or hs-cTnT above 14 ng/L
schedule: before each infusion, every 2 to 4 weeks
note: all five cases were asymptomatic and found first by troponin

description: Serial cTnI monitoring before each dose, 428 patients
statistic: share with an elevated result, the share of those who had myocarditis, and the time to the first elevation
assay: cTnI Siemens Dimension-EXL, at or above 55 ng/L
uncertainty: binomial on 42 of 428 and on 6 of 42
note: the assay differs from the two used in the main analysis

description: Rate, size and timing of troponin rises not caused by myocarditis
statistic: rate of non-myocarditis rises per patient, their median level, and their time from the first dose
uncertainty: binomial on the per-cause counts of 1077
note: van den Berg 2024 supplies the same quantity under prospective screening and is recorded under C6 as well
